headline.title: We searched "physical therapy Rancho Bernardo". Kinetic Impact appeared in none of the 19 results.
headline.detail: Large groups took the page: Select Physical Therapy, Sharp Rees-Stealy, SpineZone and ProActive, plus booking pages for One Nine and Fix Medical Group. A neighbor searching for exactly what you do never meets you.

summary: Kinetic Impact has 102 five-star reviews and clients who stay for years, moving from rehab to strength training with the same team. But in our search for physical therapy in Rancho Bernardo you didn't appear at all, while big groups with hundreds of reviews filled every spot.
